t_advice_summary_textbox.text: there are two baskets which match with certain gnomes, one will have more until supply runs out then switch

vb_textbox.text: There are two baskets red and yellow. The red basket is controlled by the pink, purple, brown and red gnomes and the yellow basket is controlled by the yellow, green and blue gnomes. Find out at the beginning which one gives you the most points and keep using that basket until the mushrooms start getting low - 1 or 0. Then switch to the next basket while it fills up.
